reviews.text: Have to say loving the KSecret line. Try it out!
reviews.zh: 不得不講我好鍾意 KSecret 呢個系列。試吓啦！

reviews.text: Eh notado mejoría en la textura de mi piel es un buen producto
reviews.zh: 我發現皮膚質地有改善，係一款好產品。

reviews.text: I am in love with this retinal I noticed smoother skin in just one use.
reviews.zh: 我完全愛上咗呢支 retinal，淨係用咗一次已經見到皮膚更滑。

reviews.text: I like this brand, have used for a week and will wait to see if there are any results
reviews.zh: 我鍾意呢個品牌，用咗一個星期，會等睇下有冇效果。

reviews.text: Loved the milder serum, so wanted to try this one
reviews.zh: 鍾意咗嗰支溫和啲嘅精華，所以想試吓呢支。

reviews.text: Finished using the 2%, so wanted to try this one,
reviews.zh: 用完嗰支 2% 嘅，所以想試吓呢支。

reviews.text: I use it at night. It’s lightweight and absorbs quickly. It helps improve my skin texture and makes my skin look smoother after a few weeks.
reviews.zh: 我夜晚用。質地輕盈，吸收得快。用咗幾個星期之後有助改善皮膚質地，皮膚望落更滑。

reviews.text: Produkt super się rozprowadza :) używam go od dwóch dni ale skóra po nim jest bardzo miękka
reviews.zh: 產品超級容易推開 :) 用咗兩日，皮膚用完之後非常柔軟。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
